description: Work with the Git market index. action=entry returns the index entry for one package, action=merge adds or updates it in a clone, action=verify checks every entry against the bytes on disk, action=readme rewrites the README package table, action=list prints the entries.

path.description: Absolute path to the package directory.

action.description: What to do; defaults to entry.

repo.description: Absolute path to the market clone holding index.json; inferred from packages/<id>/<version> when omitted.
